arcs.title: Above Marker 9
arcs.summary: Day 3: Christine sent the question — 'What is the circle' — by owl at seven forty-one Monday morning. Ashworth has not yet replied. The sketch remains on the kitchen table. Steve has measured the approach from the spur's mouth to the shelf and confirmed the Jeep will manage the grade. The circle, two centimetres, unlabelled, four millimetres above the shelf notation, is now the paper's central open question. Day 4 should deliver Ashworth's reply — ideally spare and slightly unsettling — clarifying the circle: perhaps a second shelf, a clearing, a drop, or a feature Ashworth has not named because she does not have a name for it yet. The reply should open the door for the Day 5 run.
